biography.background:
Jean-Micheng est un Android Brawler et "Martial Artist". Il a été conçu pour le combat et est très rapide et précis. Ses attaques dévastatrices permettront de repousser les ennemis tout en esquivant leurs attaques.

Comment jouer Jean-Micheng ?

  • Votre corps synthétique vous permez de survivre dans le vide de l'espace.

  • Utilisez vos poings et vos pieds vous permettent d'enchaîner d'impressionants @UUID[Actor.ESldA7Hcsr6ZnEHB.Item.sWUZvLbMTfUFT6aj]{Combo Strikes (D4)}.

  • Utilisez votre Focus pour changer de posture, choisirez vous d'être précis ou rapide ?

  • Repoussez vos ennemis avec @UUID[Actor.ESldA7Hcsr6ZnEHB.Item.vZL9OIW2hkwewZMn]{Forceful Push} et rendez-les vulnérables aux attaques suivantes !

system.description:
After making a damage roll with a Melee weapon but before dealing that damage to the target, mark a Stress to start a combo strike. When you do, roll a Combo Die and note its value. Then, roll another Combo Die again. If the value of the second die is equal to or greater than your first Combo Die, continue rolling until the latest Combo Die’s roll is less than the roll that preceeded it. Total all rolled values and add that amount to your weapon’s damage. These values cannot be adjusted by features that affect damage dice.

Your Combo Die starts as a d4. When you level up, once per tier you may use one of your advancement options to increase your Combo Die instead.

Experts in unarmed combat, brawlers hone their bodies into lethal weapons using impressive physical prowess. Whether they learned in a structured school environment or picked up their skills one fight at a time, the process is always rigorous, with brawlers developing their body and mind to work as one.
You don't need to breathe and can survive the cold vacuum of space. You don't eat but must periodically recharge.
Once per Long Rest, reroll an Action Roll using Knowledge or Finesse.
You have Advantage on rolls to negotiate contracts, leverage bureaucracy, or interact with corporate officials.

Click here to roll: [[/r 1d6]].

During a rest, roll a number of d6s equal to your Instinct and place a number of Focus tokens equal to the highest value rolled on this card. Spend a Focus to shift into a stance until you you take Severe damage, the scene ends, you mark your last Hit Point, or you shift into another stance.

You start with two martial stances from Tier 1. When you reach a new tier, take two additional stances at your tier or lower.

You can drag these features to your actor sheet.

Corporateborne are often ambitious, composed, persuasive, polished, and calculating.
